items: Prefer the smallest change that fully addresses the observed behavior.
Preserve existing interfaces and data flow whenever possible.
Verify the likely root cause before editing related code.
Run the most relevant public test first to confirm the failure.
Re-run focused tests after each targeted change.
Finish with the available compile and public validation checks.
Keep all work inside the active workspace boundaries.
Touch only files that are necessary for the fix.
Leave the workspace clean except for intentional repair changes.
Inspect the failing path and its immediate dependencies.
Compare expected and actual behavior at the smallest reproducible point.
Confirm the fix resolves the issue without changing unrelated behavior.
Use concise edits that are easy to review and explain.
Remove or simplify code only when it clearly improves correctness.
Stop after the targeted fix is validated.
